load_checkpoint_model: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a file path with optional optimizer and scaler state restoration
save_checkpoint_model: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optional optimizer, scaler, step, and positions metadata to disk
unwrap_model_wrapper: unwrap a DataParallel or FSDP wrapped model to retrieve the underlying module
unwrap_state_dict_keys: unwrap a state dictionary by stripping _orig_mod or module prefixes from key names
collect_positions_distributed: collect and aggregate shard position tensors across all distributed workers into a rank-worker dictionary
